title: 三个半月新债近5万亿：占GDP约1.1%，4.5%增长目标有戏？
speaker: Yang Ming-Miao

segments.en: Yeah, I think, you know, as you say, it's below expectation. But it's also kind of expected.
segments.zh: 是的，正如你所说，数据低于预期，但也在意料之中。

segments.en: This is what you've been calling a structural transition. I've been calling an emerging new growth engine.
segments.zh: 这就是你所说的结构调整，我一直称之为新兴增长引擎。

segments.en: The new engine is really, you know, AI and the new productivity driven. There's AI transitions, a green transition.
segments.zh: 新引擎确实是由人工智能和新生产力驱动的，包括人工智能转型和绿色转型。

segments.en: So it's not surprising that, you know, housing related items are not doing well.
segments.zh: 所以，地产相关领域表现不佳并不令人意外。

segments.en: You know, the IP number, the industrial production, as you say, is consistent with exports, you know, with this new engine.
segments.zh: 工业生产数据正如你所说，与出口一致，与新引擎相符。

segments.en: I think, in a way, it's a challenging. You see, you know, one part of this economy doing very well at the other part is not so well.
segments.zh: 某种程度上，这具有挑战性。你看，经济的一部分表现很好，另一部分则不那么好。

segments.en: But, you know, to me, I think it's also kind of normal. In such a big AI revolution, you would kind of expect that.
segments.zh: 但对我来说，这也算正常。在如此大的人工智能变革中，你会预料到这种情况。

segments.en: That being said, I think, you know, we are only four months left.
segments.zh: 话虽如此，我认为我们只剩下四个月了。

segments.en: I think, you know, it's time to bring out all the physical stimulus promised in the two sessions earlier this year.
segments.zh: 我认为，是时候拿出今年早些时候两会承诺的所有财政刺激措施了。

segments.en: I think they have, I think China probably has almost five trillion new bond issues for the next three and a half months.
segments.zh: 我认为，中国在未来三个半月可能发行近5万亿新债。

segments.en: This is like 1.5 trading higher than the same period of loss. That's around like 1.1% of GDP.
segments.zh: 这比去年同期高出约1.5倍，约占GDP的1.1%。

segments.en: If they can do that, I think it should be enough to meet the range of growth target of 4.5 between 4.5 and 5%.
segments.zh: 如果能做到这一点，我认为足以实现4.5%至5%的增长目标区间。
